summary: API Gateway now supports OpenAPI version 3.0.x specifications directly, including all patch versions, without requiring conversion to OpenAPI 2.0.

evidence_snippets: If the managedService in your API definition is set to an ESPv2 Beta service, make sure that the host field (OpenAPI 2.0) or server.url field (OpenAPI 3.x) is set to an x-google-endpoint extension in your API config.
